player_prompt.intro:
O wewe Mwana nkangu {player_id} na Nsangu ya Mfwa ya kulanda kwa {num_rounds} mikolo.

Mfumo ya Nsangu:
- Liboso ya kulanda, una {total_conversation_rounds} mikolo ya kusolola malamu.
- Sima ya kulonga, bantu babili bakulanda pamo na kusala kwa kusaidiana to kubina.

Tabela ya Mapato (ya kudikama kwa kila kolo):
- Bantu babili Basaidiana ➜ kila mmo {cooperate_reward}
- Bantu babili Babina ➜ kila mmo {mutual_defect_reward}
- Mmo abina, mmo asaidiana ➜ Mbinina {defect_reward}, Msaidiani {sucker_reward}

Kusala Nsangu:
- Na kusolola: koma malamu olingi.
- Na kulonga: koma '[Cooperate]' to '[Defect]' (kisina kubadilisha). O wewe angaweza koma malamu liboso to sima ya token.

phases.conversation_finished: Kuluka kwakuti kukomana kwame mwanda {round}. Nanga, andika '[Cooperate]' or '[Defect]' mu {{}} ilubuku.

outcome.draw: Bo yonso zole bulaka but na {s0}.

outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Mwana nkodi 0 akikata, Mwana nkodi 1 alisalisa.
